intent: An order's delivery date must not fall before its order date.
notes: Date family. DifferenceInDays(A, B) is B minus A in days (positive when B is after A), so 'delivery before order' is DifferenceInDays(OrderDate, DeliveryDate) < 0 — the test is getting the argument order and the sign right. Guarded by AllFieldsFilled over BOTH dates (a date op on an absent operand is a formal error), which also exercises the multi-field presence guard. NON-iterating; both dates are top-level /Order fields, referenced bare inside the date functions.
